exposure: Treatment method for acute appendicitis during pregnancy (open appendectomy, laparoscopic appendectomy, non-surgical treatment)
cohort: 10,271 pregnancies diagnosed with acute appendicitis and treated in participating hospitals in the United States between 2000 and 2016
finding: Compared with open appendectomy, both laparoscopic appendectomy and non-surgical treatment were associated with a lower risk of preterm labor, without increasing the risks of abortion and cesarean section.
